ROW 33's FIRST registration (issue #1408): `codex-skill-sync.py --check`/`--write` carried no negative control at all before this issue - `controls/codex-skill-resync` exists but targets a DIFFERENT script, `scripts/codex-skill-resync.sh`, the re-sync TRIGGER from #1136, not this generator's own output correctness. A SEPARATE registration per axis, per the ruling: this one covers bullet 4 only (the unremapped absolute-path gap); bullets 2 (network-detector false positives) and 3 (TYPE_CHECKING over-bundling) get their own registrations on the same gate, since all three fire on different, unrelated signals.

WHAT 'FINDING' MEANS HERE, the opposite sense from most controls in this repository: the fix is a SILENT CORRECTION - codex-skill-sync.py emits no warning line when it rewrites `~/.claude/scripts/<name>` to the relative `scripts/<name>` and bundles it. So the adapter cannot grep the gate's own output for a message; it compares the RENDERED skill content directly. 'Finding' means 'the fix's signature behavior fired': the absolute path is gone from the rendered body AND the target script is bundled. BOTH channels must agree (the same two-independent-channels discipline as the #1401/#1403 adapters) - a rewrite with no bundle, or vice versa, is a gate that ran incoherently, scored unavailable, never a detection.

WHAT THIS ESTABLISHES: a command doc naming `~/.claude/scripts/flow-finish-gate.sh` (a REAL checkout script) gets that reference rewritten to `scripts/flow-finish-gate.sh` and the script bundled alongside it - closing the exact gap Nit Store #864 found (cooneycw/skillc#264): flow-check's own generated reference.md shipped the unremapped absolute path twice, so every bundled-script invocation hit exit 127 in a Codex-only install and the completeness step read NOT_APPLICABLE in every skillc trial home. The good case proves the positive-silence side: a command doc with no absolute-path reference at all triggers neither channel, which is checked BEFORE the remap/bundle comparison (not after) - checking the comparison unconditionally misread 'nothing to remap' as the two channels disagreeing, caught while building this control.

WHAT THIS DOES NOT ESTABLISH. Nothing about a name with NO matching checkout script (`~/.claude/scripts/typo'd-name.sh`) - that is pytest-covered (test_an_unremapped_absolute_path_is_left_alone_and_named), not duplicated here, since a control's job is proving the fix is not blind on a real input, not re-walking every shape a unit test suite already owns. Nothing about `~/.codex/` paths, which are deliberately out of this bullet's remap scope (they already name the Codex-native install location, not a Claude-only one needing translation). Nothing about bullets 2/3, which have their own registrations.

anchors.why: HISTORICAL, vendored byte-for-byte from 2656225, the commit this branch was built from (the just-merged #1403 PR, immediately before any #1408 work). MEASURED against the bad case: generate_skill() passes the absolute path through unrewritten and bundles nothing - the exact production gap, reproduced from the control rather than asserted.
